description: Runs a passive security audit of a public website and returns a score out of 100, a grade from A+ to F, and findings with a fix for each. Checks HTTPS and redirects, security headers, cookie flags, TLS versions and the certificate, SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, CAA and name servers, dangling CNAME records, third-party scripts, known-vulnerable JavaScript libraries, mixed content, forms, version disclosure and security.txt. Requests only what the site serves to any visitor. Takes 5 to 40 seconds. Refuses IP addresses, ports other than 80 and 443, and any host that resolves to a private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT or cloud metadata address.

url.description: Website address to check, such as example.com or https://example.com/. Only http and https on ports 80 and 443. Any query string is removed before the request.

name: audit_website_security

cached.description: True when this result was reused from a scan of the same address in the last minute

effort.description: How much work the fix is

severity.description: critical, high, medium and low lower the score. harden is optional hardening and never counts. pass is a check that passed.

notes.description: Checks that did not finish, were skipped or saw partial data

url.description: Address requested at this hop, without query string

target.description: Final address after redirects, without query string

title: Audit website security
